These are the little things I keep

A few frames from the family archive

The soundtrack of Papa

Rafi, Kishore, and one very specific ringback tone

Baar Baar Din Ye Aaye

Mohammed Rafi — the official soundtrack of his 51st

Papa loves old Bollywood songs — especially Mohammed Rafi and Kishore Kumar. Ask him to hum along to almost anything from that era, and he will not disappoint.

Soch — Hardy Sandhu

And then there's Soch. Papa's ringback tone for so long that I don't really hear it as just a song anymore. Somewhere along the way, it became one of those sounds that my brain automatically associates with him.

Now Showing

Somehow, Salman Khan = Papa

I don't know exactly when it happened, but somewhere between Dabangg, Ek Tha Tiger, and lunches at home, Salman Khan became permanently associated with Papa in my brain. One of my core memories is watching Dabangg with him at home while eating lunch. Then there was Ek Tha Tiger. Somewhere between those movies, those afternoons, and simply growing up with him, the association just stuck.

Dabangg + Lunch at Home

Before the last page

For Papa

You've always made sure that our family has what it needs and what it wants. You've protected us, provided for us, and been strong for us in more ways than I probably even realise.

I adore you. I love you to death.

And I hope you know that so much of what I think of when I think of home is simply you being there.

— Your daughter
